tests.name: four_feature_linear_proxy_fidelity
tests.comparison: Logistic regression of is_b0_pick on four features vs lane's actual picks
tests.success_criterion: AUC >= 0.95 and calibration slope within [0.85, 1.15] when predicting lane's picks
tests.failure_criterion: AUC < 0.90 OR calibration slope outside [0.80, 1.20], indicating non-linear decision boundary

tests.name: null_pullback_redundancy_check
tests.comparison: Whether null pullback cases (n=4) are correctly predicted by four-feature composite without special imputation
tests.success_criterion: All null-pullback lane-picks (is_b0_pick=true) fall within top-quartile of four-feature Z-score distribution
tests.failure_criterion: Any null-pullback lane-pick falls below the Z-score threshold needed to achieve 70% precision on winners, proving implicit imputation logic exists

tests.name: fifth_signal_ibd_entry_contribution
tests.comparison: Partial correlation of ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct with is_b0_pick after controlling for the four features
tests.success_criterion: Partial R^2 < 0.05 for ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct, confirming it's redundant
tests.failure_criterion: Partial R^2 >= 0.10, confirming ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct is a non-redundant fifth signal

tests.name: false_positive_ruin_explanation_gap
tests.comparison: Feature values of 8 false_positive_ruin cases vs selected_winner cases on 6 momentum/volatility features
tests.success_criterion: At least 5 of 8 ruin cases fall within interquartile range of selected_winner feature values, showing four features cannot distinguish them
tests.failure_criterion: Ruin cases form a distinct cluster (>=3 sigma from winner centroid) on at least 2 features, proving non-linear decision boundary exists

tests.name: collinearity_factor_structure
tests.comparison: PCA on the four features to determine if single latent factor explains >75% variance
tests.success_criterion: PC1 explains <75% variance, confirming four independent signals rather than single underlying factor
tests.failure_criterion: PC1 explains >=80% variance, confirming four features are proxies for one latent 'chart quality' factor

tests.name: residual_predictive_power_test
tests.comparison: Whether is_b0_pick adds outcome-predictive power beyond the four-feature composite Z-score
tests.success_criterion: Logistic regression predicting outcome (winner vs ruin) shows is_b0_pick coefficient not significant (p > 0.10) after including Z-score
tests.failure_criterion: is_b0_pick remains significant (p < 0.05) after controlling for Z-score, confirming lane adds non-redundant outcome information

leakage_checks: is_b0_pick must not be used as a predictor in any test—only as the target variable for fidelity and residual power tests
snapshot_anon must not enter any model; all features are entity-level only
Outcome labels (selected_winner, false_positive_ruin) must only appear as targets, never as inputs
For the residual power test, Z-score must be computed from training-fold coefficients only, not from full-sample fits
PCA for collinearity check must use correlation matrix (standardized features) to avoid scale artifacts
